folder_name: RUBICON - 2026-08-07 - THESE BEARS JUST FLIPPED BULLISH - RECORD ORDER
story_thesis: Both published bearish top-or-correction frameworks around the 2025 high, stayed bearish as Bitcoin sold off toward $60K, then both disclosed buying around that zone before arriving at different current views.
